results.title: Assam Police Firing: Two Personnel Killed, Two Injured in Boko Outpost
results.description: The deceased have been identified as Fazrul Ali and Indrajit Bora, who were serving as the officer-in-charge of the Gamerimura Police Outpost

results.title: Kanohar Electricals to launch Rs 1,056-crore IPO on September 8, sets price band at Rs 601-632 per share
results.description: Kanohar Electricals IPO | The company is raising up to Rs 300 crore through a fresh issue of shares, while promoter entity K Sons Family Trust will sell 1.19 crore shares worth Rs 755.7 crore through an offer for sale (OFS).
